texts.title: Rabbana dua #1
texts.transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minnaa innaka Antas Samee’ul Aleem
texts.meaning_en: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
texts.stated_purpose: You can recite this du’a whenever you would like for Allah (swt) to accept whatever good you’ve just done. Du’a Prophet Ibrahim (as) recited after building the kaaba with his son.
texts.arabic: وَإِذْ يَرْفَعُ إِبْرَٰهِۦمُ ٱلْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ ٱلْبَيْتِ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلُ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

texts.stated_purpose: A du’a for provision. Provision is all encompassing term meaning to supply with food, money, or way to make a living. All good provisions come from Allah (swt), we turn to him and ask him to provide…
texts.arabic: قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ٱللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًۭا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةًۭ مِّنكَ ۖ وَٱرْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ

texts.transliteration: Rabbanaa zalamnaaa anfusanaa wa illam taghfir lanaa wa tarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal khaasireen
texts.meaning_en: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.

texts.title: Rabbana dua #21
texts.transliteration: Rabbanaa laa taj’alnaa ma’al qawmiz zaalimeen
texts.meaning_en: Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.

texts.transliteration: Rabbanaf-tah bainana wa baina qawmina bil haqqi wa anta Khairul Fatiheen
texts.meaning_en: Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision.

texts.title: Rabbana dua #23
texts.transliteration: Rabbanaaa afrigh ‘alainaa sabranw wa tawaffanaa muslimeen
texts.meaning_en: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You].

texts.transliteration: 85. Rabbana la taj’alna fitnatal lil-qawmidh-Dhalimeen ; 86. wa najjina bi- Rahmatika minal qawmil kafireen

texts.transliteration: Rabbanaa wasi’ta kulla shai’ir rahmatanw wa ‘ilman faghfir lillazeena taaboo wattaba’oo sabeelaka wa qihim ‘azaabal Jaheem
texts.meaning_en: Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.
texts.stated_purpose: Allah’s (swt) knowledge and his mercy know no limit, it is infinite. This du’a asks Allah (swt) to be merciful towards all those who believe and have sought istighfar (repentance) from their creator.
texts.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ ٱلْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ رَّحْمَةًۭ وَعِلْمًۭا فَٱغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

texts.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌۭ وَلَا نَوْمٌۭ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

texts.source: The Key to a Successful Day (daily adhkar)
texts.title: The three Quls (3x morning & evening) [Mornings & Evenings]
texts.transliteration: Qul Huwallāhu Aḥad / Qul a‘ūdhū birabbil-falaq / Qul a‘ūdhū birabbin-nās
texts.meaning_en: Surah al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and al-Nas. “Whoever recites these three times in the morning and evening, they will suffice him against everything.”
texts.stated_purpose: Recited three times morning and evening; potent in repelling magic, the evil eye and every form of evil.
texts.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ

texts.source: The Key to a Successful Day (daily adhkar)
texts.title: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah [Mornings & Evenings]
texts.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥal-mulku lillāhi wal-ḥamdu lillāhi...
texts.meaning_en: We have started a new day and with it all dominion is Allah’s... I ask You for the good in this day... I take refuge in You from laziness, helpless old age, the Fire and the grave.
texts.stated_purpose: Morning and evening remembrance asking for the day’s good and refuge from its evil.
texts.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ

texts.title: Allahumma bika asbahna (morning) [Mornings & Evenings]

texts.source: The Key to a Successful Day (daily adhkar)
texts.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar (chief prayer for forgiveness) [Mornings & Evenings]
texts.transliteration: Allāhumma Anta Rabbī lā ilāha illā Anta, khalaqtanī wa anā ‘abduka...
texts.meaning_en: O Allah, You are my Lord... I acknowledge Your blessings upon me and I admit my sins. Forgive me, for there is none who forgives sins besides You.
texts.stated_purpose: Whoever recites this with conviction in the morning or evening and dies that day or night enters Paradise.
texts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

texts.source: The Key to a Successful Day (daily adhkar)
texts.title: Calling creation to witness (4x) [Mornings & Evenings]
texts.transliteration: Allāhumma innī aṣbaḥtu ush-hiduka wa ush-hidu ḥamalata ‘arshika...
texts.meaning_en: O Allah, I call upon You, the bearers of Your Throne, Your angels and all creation to bear witness that You are Allah... and that Muhammad is Your servant and Messenger.
texts.stated_purpose: Said four times in the morning or evening; Allah will spare its reciter from the fire of Hell.
texts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتَكَ وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ

texts.source: The Key to a Successful Day (daily adhkar)
texts.title: Thanking Allah for every blessing [Mornings & Evenings]
texts.transliteration: Allāhumma mā aṣbaḥa bī min ni‘matin aw bi aḥadin min khalqika faminka waḥdaka...
texts.meaning_en: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me or any of Your creatures by morning is from You alone... All praise is for You and gratitude is due to You.
texts.stated_purpose: Whoever recites this in the morning has completed his obligation to thank Allah for that day.
texts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ

texts.source: The Key to a Successful Day (daily adhkar)
texts.title: Health of body, hearing & sight (3x) [Mornings & Evenings]
texts.transliteration: Allāhumma ‘āfinī fī badanī, Allāhumma ‘āfinī fī sam‘ī, Allāhumma ‘āfinī fī baṣarī...
texts.meaning_en: O Allah, grant my body good health, preserve my hearing and my sight... I take refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and from the punishment of the grave.
texts.stated_purpose: Said three times morning and evening for health and wellbeing.
texts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

texts.title: Hasbiyallah (7x) [Mornings & Evenings]
texts.transliteration: Ḥasbiyallāhu lā ilāha illā Huwa ‘alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul-‘Arshil-‘Aẓīm
texts.meaning_en: Allah is sufficient for me. There is none worthy of worship but Him. I have placed my trust in Him, He is Lord of the Majestic Throne.
texts.stated_purpose: Said seven times morning and evening; Allah will grant its reciter what he desires of this world and the next.
texts.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ

texts.source: The Key to a Successful Day (daily adhkar)
texts.title: Pardon and wellbeing in everything [Mornings & Evenings]
texts.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’alukal-‘afwa wal-‘āfiyata fid-dunyā wal-ākhirati...
texts.meaning_en: O Allah, I ask for Your pardon and good health in this world and the next, in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family and my wealth... guard me from every direction.
texts.stated_purpose: A comprehensive morning and evening prayer for pardon, safety and covering of faults.
texts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي

texts.source: The Key to a Successful Day (daily adhkar)
texts.title: Refuge from the evil of self and Satan [Mornings & Evenings]
texts.meaning_en: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen... I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his shirk, and from harming myself or any Muslim.
texts.stated_purpose: Morning and evening protection from one’s own evil and the whispers of Satan.
texts.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ

texts.source: The Key to a Successful Day (daily adhkar)
texts.title: Bismillah – nothing can harm (3x) [Mornings & Evenings]
texts.transliteration: Bismillāhil-ladhī lā yaḍurru ma‘as-mihī shay’un fil-arḍi wa lā fis-samā’i...
texts.meaning_en: In the Name of Allah with whose Name nothing can cause harm, neither in the earth nor in the heavens. He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
texts.stated_purpose: Whoever recites it three times morning or evening will not be afflicted by any calamity.
texts.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

texts.title: Pleased with Allah, Islam and the Prophet (3x) [Mornings & Evenings]
texts.transliteration: Raḍītu billāhi Rabban, wa bil-Islāmi dīnan, wa bi Muḥammadin Nabiyyan

texts.source: The Key to a Successful Day (daily adhkar)
texts.title: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum – set my affairs right [Mornings & Evenings]
texts.transliteration: Yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūmu biraḥmatika astaghīthu aṣliḥ lī sha’nī kullahu...
texts.meaning_en: O Ever Living One, O Self-Sustaining One, by Your mercy I ask for Your support in setting all my affairs right. Do not leave me to my soul for the blink of an eye.
texts.stated_purpose: A cry for help in distress, asking Allah to correct all one’s affairs.

texts.source: The Key to a Successful Day (daily adhkar)
texts.title: Good of this day / this night (16a & 16b) [Mornings & Evenings]
texts.transliteration: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥal-mulku lillāhi Rabbil-‘ālamīn... khayra hādhal-yawmi: fatḥahu wa naṣrahu wa nūrahu... / Amsaynā...
texts.meaning_en: O Allah, I ask You for the good in this day (or night): its victory, its help, its light, its blessings and its guidance; I take refuge in You from its evil.
texts.stated_purpose: Version (a) said in the morning, version (b) in the evening.

texts.meaning_en: We have started a new day upon the natural religion of Islam, the statement of sincerity, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad and the faith of our father Ibrahim.
texts.stated_purpose: Morning and evening declaration of remaining firm upon Islam.

texts.title: La ilaha illallah (10x) [Mornings & Evenings]
texts.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lahū, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamdu...

texts.source: The Key to a Successful Day (daily adhkar)
texts.title: SubhanAllah – as much as His creation (3x) [Mornings & Evenings]
texts.transliteration: Subḥānallāhi wa biḥamdihī: ‘adada khalqihī, wa riḍā nafsihī, wa zinata ‘arshihī wa midāda kalimātihī

texts.title: Surah al-Fatihah (7x) – ruqyah
texts.meaning_en: The opening chapter of the Quran, recited seven times as ruqyah (Arabic text not printed in a readable form in this booklet).
texts.stated_purpose: One of the strongest ruqyah recitations; a cure for illness, evil eye and magic.

texts.title: Ayah al-Kursi – ruqyah
texts.meaning_en: The Verse of the Throne, describing Allah’s living, self-sustaining power over the heavens and the earth.
texts.stated_purpose: The strongest protection against the evil of jinn; it repels Satan.
texts.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌۭ وَلَا نَوْمٌۭ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

texts.title: Last verses of Surah al-Baqarah
texts.meaning_en: The closing verses of Surah al-Baqarah, recited in ruqyah and before sleeping.
texts.stated_purpose: “Whoever recites them at night, they will suffice him.” Protection through the night.
texts.arabic: لِّلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَإِن تُبْدُوا۟ مَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ يُحَاسِبْكُم بِهِ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَيَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ ءَامَنَ ٱلرَّسُولُ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ ءَامَنَ بِٱللَّهِ وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتِهِۦ وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَرُسُلِهِۦ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍۢ مِّن رُّسُلِهِۦ ۚ وَقَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًۭا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ

texts.title: Verses against magic – Surah al-A‘raf
texts.meaning_en: The verses of Musa’s staff swallowing the magicians’ falsehood: “So the truth was established and what they were doing was made vain.”

texts.title: Verse against magic – Surah Ta-Ha
texts.meaning_en: “Throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is only a magician’s trick, and the magician will not succeed wherever he goes.”
